scenes.chapter: A self-employment loss: sideways, back and which first

steps.caption: A loss can carry forward, sideways, or back to an earlier year.
steps.headline: A loss, three ways
steps.instruction: Read the three claims this page offers: carry forward, carry sideways and carry back to an earlier year.

steps.caption: The self-employment business's own ID.
steps.headline: The self-employment ID
steps.instruction: Enter the self-employment business ID in Business ID.

steps.caption: HMRC's sandbox needs this tax year for carry-back claims.
steps.headline: Choose the tax year
steps.instruction: Choose 2026-27 in the Tax year list.

steps.caption: The sandbox's current tax year hasn't really ended, so suspend that check.
steps.headline: Suspend the tax year check
steps.instruction: Tick Suspend temporal validations; the sandbox's tax year has not ended.

steps.caption: Load this business's loss position for the year.
steps.headline: Load the loss position

steps.caption: Carry sideways: set this year's loss against this year's other income.
steps.headline: Carry the loss sideways
steps.instruction: Enter the loss to set against this year's other income in Loss set against this year's other income.

steps.caption: Carry back: set the rest against an earlier year's general income.
steps.headline: Carry the loss back
steps.instruction: Enter the loss to set against an earlier year's general income in Set against an earlier year's general income.

steps.caption: Claiming both at once means saying which one HMRC applies first.
steps.headline: Which claim goes first
steps.instruction: Read the Which claim applies first section, which appears when you claim both.

steps.caption: Sideways first, then whatever is left carries back.
steps.headline: Sideways applies first
steps.instruction: Choose Carry sideways in the Which claim applies first list.

steps.caption: Save the claim.
steps.headline: Save the claim

steps.label: Waiting for HMRC
steps.caption: HMRC accepts the claim.
steps.headline: HMRC accepts the claim
steps.instruction: Read the result to check that HMRC accepted the claim.

steps.caption: Saved. This is the record as submitted: its reference, its status and the date.
steps.headline: The record as submitted
steps.instruction: Read the record for its reference, its status and the date.

steps.caption: Every loss and claim you sent is on the record, with which applies first.
steps.headline: Keep this copy
steps.instruction: Check each loss and claim in the record, and which applies first, and keep your copy.
